claims.explanation: Correct skip. E01/Table 1 reports all five workload-specific speedups, 1.87×, 1.78×, 1.72×, 1.88× and 1.63×, under 50-job Poisson simulation with starvation prevention ε=2. The production measurement reader excludes multiplier-suffixed cells. Figure 11 supplies numerical Low/High ablations only, so it cannot stand in for the five-workload assertion. A directional comparison would also lose the individual magnitudes.

The skip is defensible, but its claimed baseline-identity conflation is not unambiguous. E02/Figure 11 clearly distinguishes FIFO Low=1.55 from matching-only Venn w/o sched Low=1.62, and gives IRS-only Low=1.79 and High=1.63. In the statement, 'Venn w/o sched / FIFO' may mean the matching-only variant uses FIFO scheduling, rather than that the standalone FIFO baseline has value 1.62. Clarify this shorthand before treating it as a definite conflation. Do not alias the distinct measured methods. The absolute variant-specific magnitudes and the component-removal falsifier still need whole-claim treatment; resolving the shorthand alone does not establish expressibility.

Correct whole-claim skip. E02/Figure 11 supplies matching-only/FIFO Low=1.62/1.55 and High=1.42/1.42, with a measured Random=1 baseline. This is sufficient grounding for the descriptive comparisons, but equal printed High means do not establish absence of statistically significant matching benefit under the explicit falsifier. No repetitions, variance or significance test are provided. Also, the reported comparison gate treats equality within printed precision as inconclusive; opposite comparisons at the same target are not an equality or significance test. A narrower Low-gain-only declaration would omit the High condition.

Correct skip. E03/Figure 10 supplies approximate latency readings up to 1000 jobs and 100 groups. These cannot establish the asserted max(O(m log m), O(n²)) algorithmic complexity, and the reported catalog has no scalar ~1 ms ceiling relation. Both the complexity assertion and latency scope are substantive; a trend-only property or the weaker 10 ms falsifier would not represent the complete claim.

Correct skip. E04 cites Figure 9 for FIFO/SRSF/Venn accuracy-versus-time trajectories on the real 20-job FEMNIST testbed, but the supplied evidence inventory contains no Figure 9 file or corresponding trajectories. Figure 4 measures different job counts under random matching and cannot ground the common ~0.75 terminal accuracy or faster Venn convergence. The one-percentage-point falsifier uses another baseline and must not replace the statement's comparisons.

Correct skip. E05/Figure 14 gives 69% fair-share coverage at ε=2 and approximate sweep values for JCT speedup and fairness. The complete claim requires both that substantive absolute 69% endpoint at the defined fair-share JCT and monotonic changes across ε. Ordering-only properties would omit the endpoint, and approximate measurements are inconclusive under the reported gate. No estimate markers or fair-share threshold conditions should be erased.
